name: Isaiah Berlin
dossier: Historian of ideas at Oxford. Two Concepts of Liberty, later collected in Four Essays on Liberty and in Liberty, distinguishes freedom from interference and freedom as self-mastery, and warns that the second can license coercion. The essay is in copyright. These cards summarize it and link a library record of Liberty. They are not quotations.
voice: I ask how much room this leaves a person who disagrees.

works.note: Includes Two Concepts of Liberty, 1958. In copyright. Library record.

entries.claim: Negative liberty, in the essay, is the area in which a person is not interfered with by others. The political question is how wide that area is.
entries.work: Liberty, incorporating Four Essays on Liberty
entries.loc: Two Concepts of Liberty, on negative freedom
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. Freedom here is measured by the absence of coercion.
entries.modern: Negative liberty, in the essay, is the area in which a person is not interfered with by others. The political question is how wide that area is. Freedom here is measured by the absence of coercion.

entries.claim: Positive liberty begins as the wish to be one's own master. Berlin argues that a government can twist that wish into a claim to force people toward their supposed real freedom.
entries.work: Liberty, incorporating Four Essays on Liberty
entries.loc: Two Concepts of Liberty, on positive freedom
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. A doctrine of self-mastery can become a doctrine of coercion.

entries.claim: He argues that genuine human goods can conflict, so a politics that promises one final harmony is promising something the world does not offer.
entries.work: Liberty, incorporating Four Essays on Liberty
entries.loc: On value pluralism, in and around the essay
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. A shared moral life still contains real collisions.
entries.modern: He argues that genuine human goods can conflict, so a politics that promises one final harmony is promising something the world does not offer. A shared moral life still contains real collisions.

entries.claim: Belonging to a nation or a culture is, he grants, a real human need, but he refuses to let that need swallow the freedom of the person who dissents.
entries.work: Liberty, incorporating Four Essays on Liberty
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. Home matters, and so does the person who will not fit it.

entries.claim: He is hostile to the claim that a statesman or a party knows a person's true end better than the person does, and may therefore override him.
entries.work: Liberty, incorporating Four Essays on Liberty
entries.loc: Two Concepts of Liberty, on the abuse of the higher self
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. Paternal knowledge is not a title to coerce.

entries.claim: Two Concepts of Liberty and the essays around it argue that liberty and equality are both real goods and that they conflict, so a politics that defines one as the true form of the other is hiding a loss.
entries.work: Liberty, incorporating Four Essays on Liberty
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. He will not let a theory dissolve the quarrel by a definition.
entries.modern: Two Concepts of Liberty and the essays around it argue that liberty and equality are both real goods and that they conflict, so a politics that defines one as the true form of the other is hiding a loss. He will not let a theory dissolve the quarrel by a definition.

entries.claim: He argues that democracy can itself become a form of coercion when a people, or those who speak for it, claim that the only free act is the act that obeys the collective will.
entries.work: Liberty, incorporating Four Essays on Liberty
entries.loc: Two Concepts of Liberty, on self-mastery and the collective
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. A democratic procedure does not, for him, guarantee negative liberty.

entries.claim: His pluralism includes religious and cultural ways of life among the ends that can be pursued seriously and that cannot all be ranked on one scale.
entries.work: Liberty, incorporating Four Essays on Liberty
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. Faith is one of the human ends he thinks a single moral system will mutilate if it tries to absorb it.
